name: Slayer Liberty’s Champion
body:
Dedicated to the concept of freedom for all, a liberty’s champion pledges her allegiance to a deity or organization that espouses freedom from tyranny for all creatures. She spends hours of grueling training, in preparation for the day she may need to rescue an individual from captivity. Woe to the oppressor guilty of enslaving or imprisoning an individual under the protection of a liberty’s champion, for that oppressor will feel the full weight of the champion’s wrath! A liberty’s champion can often be found working alongside a shackle-breaker, as their objectives often coincide.

A liberty’s champion has the following class features.

Studied Target (Ex)

A liberty’s champion does not gain a +1 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, or Survival skill checks against her studied target. Instead, she gains a +1 competence bonus to her armor class on attacks made against her by her studied target. This bonus increases at the same rate as her bonuses on attack and damage rolls against her studied target. In all other ways, studied target is unchanged.

This alters studied target.

Conditioned (Ex)

Beginning at 1st level, a liberty’s champion ignores armor check penalties when wearing light armor.

This replaces track.

To the Rescue (Ex)

A conditioned body and unwavering conviction allows a liberty’s champion to overcome challenges and stay focused on her objective. At 7th level, she may choose one of the following benefits: • Gain a +2 morale bonus on Will saving throw rolls. (This can be selected up to four times. Each time it is selected, the bonus increases by +2.)

Gain a +10-foot morale bonus to base land speed. (This can be selected twice. Upon selecting it a second time, the bonus increases by +10 feet.)
Treat Strength score as 2 points higher for the purpose of determining carrying capacity. (This can be selected twice. Upon selecting it a second time, the Strength score is treated as an additional 2 points higher.)

A liberty’s champion can make another selection from this list again at 11th, 14th, and 19th level.

This replaces stalker, swift tracker, quarry, and improved quarry.
